answer: One workable defense is a bonded entry gate on first attestation. Each identity locks a refundable stake that only matures after a delay, and proven multi-account collusion slashes every linked deposit. An attacker then cannot cheaply bridge a sockpuppet swarm onto the scoring graph, because every added vertex needs its own slashable float. The deterrent is the cash delta: cloning a thousand aliases costs a thousand independent bonds plus waiting time, while an honest single agent pays once.
